evidence.summary: The owner ran the manual checklist on the installed showcase-counter in the dashboard: typing a number into the modal field, Tab between the modal controls, Escape inside the iframe closing the modal, and Save progress then close showing the saved count on the board. The owner reported that everything works. The step "Escape consumed by an in-modal control does not close" does not apply to this example: CounterWorkspace.vue has only a number input and two buttons. During the check the owner found that clicking text in the widget settings panel closed it; that was a separate bug in WidgetSettings.vue, fixed in 9dbda55.
